annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because the speaker investigates and criticizes BitConnect, describing its exchange concentration and code repository as evidence that it may be a Ponzi or pump-and-dump scheme. Although he says he bought BCC and intends to withdraw his initial investment and interest, the overall message warns the crypto community rather than encouraging viewers to participate.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: N01 fits because the video's central communicative action is examining alleged scam indicators and warning viewers. The speaker explicitly labels the project a Ponzi, questions its trading-volume and exchange claims, critiques its repository, and closes by saying he is trying to warn the community.
